instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Make Stripe hold one lasting payment link for every priced option of my offers, with the buyer plan page and my discount codes", and give it owner; after_payment_url.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:set-up-stripe-payment-links and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give owner (a name that marks the Stripe objects as yours) and after_payment_url (where a buyer lands after paying: an offer row with post_purchase_route_path lands at that path under it, any other at its root).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:commercial-offer (records:list); checkout-code-adjustment (records:list).
